concepts.definition: The offense gets four plays (downs) to gain 10 yards. Gain them and the count resets.
concepts.exampleLine: They have to go for it on fourth down.

concepts.definition: The player who runs the offense and throws most passes.
concepts.exampleLine: Their quarterback looks calm under pressure.

concepts.definition: Sixty minutes of playing time in four quarters; the clock stops often, so games take about three hours.
concepts.exampleLine: They are just trying to run out the clock.

concepts.definition: The defensive backs: cornerbacks and safeties who cover receivers.
The safety who lines up on the tight end side and helps against the run and short passes.
concepts.exampleLine: The strong safety came up to stop the run.

payload.title: Hockey night
payload.setting: She texts after her team wins in overtime.

exchanges.theirMessage: OT winner!! Power play goal, we finally got the man advantage.

replies.text: Nice, the power play finally clicked?
replies.coachNote: You picked up the term and asked about it.

replies.theirResponse: ...We did. It is in my text.

payload.closingNote: A power play is a two-minute man advantage after a penalty.
